plugins.name: higgsfield-brief-to-pipeline
plugins.description: Turns a brief plus a folder of reference images into an optimal, credit-aware Higgsfield pipeline. Shows an HTML process preview as a mandatory approval gate before spending any credits, then executes stage-by-stage with auto-verification, human gates, and zero-credit deterministic text/dimension overlays.
